summary: Backend (16 pytest) + frontend smoke tests for Pocket Wallet app. All 16 backend endpoints pass (accounts/categories/records CRUD, analytics summary/balance-trend/expenses-structure/report/cash-flow). Transfer balance effect verified (cash->bank +1100). _id excluded everywhere. Frontend loads with top nav (Dashboard/Accounts/Records/Analytics), Record button, period switcher (May 2026). Account creation modal works end-to-end (UI_TEST_Acct created, toast shown, balance card appears on dashboard). Dashboard shows Balance/Cash Flow/Spending cards, Balance Trend area chart and Expenses Structure donut. AddRecord modal opens and 'Record added' toast appears on save.

ui_bugs.issue: After AddRecord save toast 'Record added' appears, but Records list shows 'Found 0 records' for May 2026 (record may have been saved with a different date than current period, or expense was created without explicit account/date defaults loading). Needs verification of default date/account in AddRecordModal.

Tab label 'Report' not found by exact text - actual label likely 'Incomes & Expenses report'. Cosmetic; also Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)' for hidden tab containers (ResponsiveContainer in inactive tab panels) - consider lazy render or fixed height.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' in Add Account and Add Record modals. Add DialogDescription for a11y.

action_items: Investigate why a record created via AddRecordModal does not appear in current-month list (verify default date binding and default account_id in modal state).
Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to AddAccountModal and AddRecordModal for accessibility.
Hide or lazy-mount Recharts ResponsiveContainer for inactive Analytics tabs to avoid width(-1) warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: list_records search filter overwrites $or used by account_id filter incorrectly — uses q.get('$or', []) + [...] but Mongo $or with mixed conditions can yield unintended OR with account filter; consider $and wrapping.
server.py: cascade delete on /accounts/{id} silently deletes records — acceptable for demo but worth logging.
Analytics summary computes total_balance over all-time and account_balances all-time, but income/expense are period-scoped — documented behaviour but worth surfacing in UI label.
Pydantic Record.date is a plain str; no validation that it's ISO YYYY-MM-DD — bad dates would break analytics string comparisons.
test_credentials: N/A - single demo user, no auth
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+cleanup TEST_Bank account and TEST_ records. Frontend left one 'UI_TEST_Acct' account in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend APIs pass. Main investigation: AddRecordModal save flow vs Records list refresh/date matching. Default seed Cash account + 12 categories confirmed. INR ₹ currency shown correctly.
